caption:
This cone isn't shorter than the cylinder. It's taller.

A cone holds 1/3 of a matching cylinder, so to hold the same volume it needs 3 times the height.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: Same radius, same volume: the cone is 3 times taller.

youtube.title: Cone vs Cylinder With Equal Volume | SAT Geometry
youtube.description: Set (1/3)πr²h equal to πr²h and see why the cone must be taller. SAT-style practice question (original).
